sql: SELECT TOP 10 o.ClassNumber AS savedCartNumber, ad.Name AS name, cf.parentSku AS configurableSku, cf.parentName AS configurableName, cf.variantSku AS configurableVariantSku, cf.variantName AS configurableVariantName, pz1.PersonalizeCode AS configurablePersonalization1, pz2.PersonalizeCode AS configurablePersonalization2, gr.parentSku AS groupSku, gr.parentName AS groupName, gr.childSku AS groupChildSku, gr.childName AS groupChildName, bp.parentSku AS bundleSku, bp.parentName AS bundleName, b1.SKU AS bundleChild1Sku, b1.ProductName AS bundleChild1Name, b2.SKU AS bundleChild2Sku, b2.ProductName AS bundleChild2Name, b3.SKU AS bundleChild3Sku, b3.ProductName AS bundleChild3Name, sp.parentSku AS simpleSku, sp.parentName AS simpleName, sp.addOnGroupName AS simpleAddOnGroupName, sp.addOnSku AS simpleAddOnSku, sp.addOnName AS simpleAddOnName FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder o INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCPOrderClass oc ON oc.CPOrderClassId = o.ClassId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeOrderAdditionalDetail ad ON ad.OrderId = o.OrderId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = o.PortalId CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 cm.Sku AS parentSku, cm.ProductName AS parentName, cl.SKU AS variantSku, cl.ProductName AS variantName, cl.OrderProductId AS lineId FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderParentProductMapping cm INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeOrderProduct cl ON cl.OrderProductId = cm.OrderProductId WHERE cm.OrderId = o.OrderId AND cm.ProductType = @configurableType AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT av.AttributeCode) FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderProductAttributeValue av WHERE av.OrderProductId = cl.OrderProductId AND av.IsConfigurable = @isConfigurable) >= @minVariantAttributes AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pc.PersonalizeCode) FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderProductPersonalisation pc WHERE pc.MappingId = cl.OrderProductId) >= @minPersonalizations ORDER BY cm.Sku, cl.SKU) cf OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 pa.PersonalizeCode FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderProductPersonalisation pa WHERE pa.MappingId = cf.lineId ORDER BY pa.PersonalizeCode) pz1 OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 pb.PersonalizeCode FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderProductPersonalisation pb WHERE pb.MappingId = cf.lineId AND pb.PersonalizeCode > pz1.PersonalizeCode ORDER BY pb.PersonalizeCode) pz2 CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 gm.Sku AS parentSku, gm.ProductName AS parentName, gl.SKU AS childSku, gl.ProductName AS childName FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderParentProductMapping gm INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeOrderProduct gl ON gl.OrderProductId = gm.OrderProductId WHERE gm.OrderId = o.OrderId AND gm.ProductType = @groupedType ORDER BY gm.Sku, gl.SKU) gr CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 bm.ParentOrderProductId AS parentId, bm.Sku AS parentSku, bm.ProductName AS parentName FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderParentProductMapping bm WHERE bm.OrderId = o.OrderId AND bm.ProductType = @bundleType AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bc.OrderProductId) FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderParentProductMapping bc WHERE bc.OrderId = o.OrderId AND bc.ParentOrderProductId = bm.ParentOrderProductId AND bc.ProductType = @bundleType) >= @minBundleChildren ORDER BY bm.Sku, bm.ParentOrderProductId) bp CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 x1.SKU, x1.ProductName FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderParentProductMapping y1 INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeOrderProduct x1 ON x1.OrderProductId = y1.OrderProductId WHERE y1.OrderId = o.OrderId AND y1.ParentOrderProductId = bp.parentId AND y1.ProductType = @bundleType ORDER BY x1.SKU) b1 OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 x2.SKU, x2.ProductName FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderParentProductMapping y2 INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeOrderProduct x2 ON x2.OrderProductId = y2.OrderProductId WHERE y2.OrderId = o.OrderId AND y2.ParentOrderProductId = bp.parentId AND y2.ProductType = @bundleType AND x2.SKU > b1.SKU ORDER BY x2.SKU) b2 OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 x3.SKU, x3.ProductName FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderParentProductMapping y3 INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeOrderProduct x3 ON x3.OrderProductId = y3.OrderProductId WHERE y3.OrderId = o.OrderId AND y3.ParentOrderProductId = bp.parentId AND y3.ProductType = @bundleType AND x3.SKU > b2.SKU ORDER BY x3.SKU) b3 CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 sm.Sku AS parentSku, sm.ProductName AS parentName, sa.AddOnGroupName AS addOnGroupName, sa.SKU AS addOnSku, sa.ProductName AS addOnName FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderParentProductMapping sm INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeOrderProduct sa ON sa.OrderProductId = sm.OrderProductId WHERE sm.OrderId = o.OrderId AND sm.ProductType = @simpleType AND sa.IsAddOn = @isAddOn ORDER BY sm.Sku, sa.SKU) sp WHERE oc.ClassCode = @savedCartClass AND po.StoreCode = @store AND (@owner IS NULL OR o.UserId = @owner) AND ad.Name IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.ProductType) FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderParentProductMapping pt WHERE pt.OrderId = o.OrderId) >= @minParentProductTypes AND (@preferred IS NULL OR o.ClassNumber = @preferred) ORDER BY o.ClassNumber
